lines.text: I do not write notes. I do not watch.
I listen. It is a different job.
Whoever sent that wanted you here. So. You came.
Go and sleep. It will be a long five years.
My sister used to feed the fish here.
You went down for that.
I have kept one coil lit alone for a long time.
I begin to suspect I was doing it wrong.
It needs people round it. Not soldiers. Witnesses.
It was designed for a crowd. I had forgotten.
I do not know many people. You seem to.
A poet wrote, a long time ago…
At night there is no light, and colours are not seen;
Hence we know what light is by its opposite, darkness.
Describe it.
A thermodynamically incontinent leviathan,
hoarding our electrons.
A greedy generator.
Three parts. Two I can specify. One I cannot.
The professor fitted that one herself. Would not let us watch.
Her methodology was incontrovertibly,
perspicaciously communitarian.
She liked people. The part should come from one.
Ask my niece. Ask properly.
A crystal. Of course. She would hide a jewel in a machine.
Then we have a coil. We lack only a way in.
A poet wrote, a long time ago…
What was the friendship of lights like us to darkness?
How can light dwell together with darkness?
Antidisestablishmentarian it is not. But it was splendiferous.
Two of them were. It went well.
She wrote that for me. She was always early.
No. Thank you. Give me the lead.
I have been perambulating the perimeter of my own procrastination.
Forty years. Yes.
A poet wrote, a long time ago:
"Hearken to the reed-flute, how it discourses
When complaining of the pains of separation."
My notebook. When you are a finalist. Not before.
A poet wrote: "For from contraries contraries are
brought forth, / Out of darkness was created light."
Thank you for the noise.
Triskaidekaphobia I have none; trinities I adore. Three!
I am just happy.
A poet wrote: "He who abides far away from his home
Is ever longing for the day he shall return."
A good wedding. Somebody planned this one.
An old argument.
Forty. Good.
Sesquipedalian sky-sorcery, executed with immaculate alacrity.
Check. Well flown.
A poet wrote this, long ago. Not I.
"The mirror of the heart must needs be polished
Before you can distinguish fair and foul therein."
A poet's line. Not mine.
"The water of life is hidden in the land of darkness."
A poet asked this, long ago:
"Knowest thou why thy mirror reflects not?
Because the rust has not been scoured from its face."
Your counterfeit was hopelessly, magnificently two-dimensional.
It couldn't be drawn.
Pneumonoultramicroscopic patience is required
for page two hundred and six.
So is waiting. Read.
A magnanimous concatenation of synchronicity!
Ten faculties, one denominator!
Everybody came.
Someone who will leave.
A poet wrote, long ago:
'Oftentimes hope succeeds to hopelessness,
Many times does sunlight succeed to darkness.'
A poet wrote:
'Worldly senses are the ladder of earth,
Spiritual senses are the ladder of heaven.'
We shall need both. Mind your step.
Quickly now. I have kept everyone waiting.
I believe this is yours.
I have had it far too long.
Someone who will leave.
A poet's words, not mine:
'This eye and that lamp are two lights, each individual;
When they came together, no one distinguished them.'
Floccinaucinihilipilification of fear:
I hereby value it at nothing.
I am not afraid any more.
'And if the sun did not fare by wing and foot every night,
How would the world be illuminated at morning-tide?'
Ai—
Somebody chose your door. One day, choose well.
You again. Good. Stand outside the fence.
Good evening. Mind the cable. It minds you less.
Ah. The fresher who runs toward things.
Sit, if you like. Not there. Beside it.
You came by the long path. Sensible.
Go and sleep. The coil will not miss you.
Go. Take the lit road home.
Thank you for coming. People forget to.
Thank you. Put it down gently. Everything here is old.
Noted. With gratitude. In that order.
I heard the question. I am choosing not to have heard it.
That is a long story. I only have short ones.
No.
No. Ask me again in a year. The answer will be shorter.
Have you eaten? The coil can wait. You cannot.
Did you greet the porter? Go back and greet him.
Crepuscular illumination is insufficient. …It is getting dark.
Your trajectory is lamentably circumlocutory. …You took the long way.
Borborygmus. Yours. Audible from the fence. …Go and eat.
There. Now you can hear it hum.
Stay near people. That is the whole trick.
The dark is not an enemy. It is what is there before somebody bothers.
Somebody bothered. Good.
Rain does not trouble the coil. It troubles the shoes.
Stand in the shade. The coil is warm enough for both of us.
Fuse wire. You have been paying attention.
Tea. From Audu's. You know my habits now. Hm.
A torch with a man's face on it. I will keep it in a drawer.
A good screwdriver. Nobody has given me a tool in a long while.
One note. Still one note. Good.
Copper, enamel, patience. Mostly patience.
Measure twice. Then ask someone to measure. Then cut.
Energy in, light out. The rest is commentary.
Six dots. Somebody keeps drawing them on the kerb. Hm.
Late. Go home by the lamps.
The cats are early tonight.
The note. You still carry it. Hm.
Every expert was once the one asking where the Senate is.
Forty first days. Every one of them looked like fear.
You found the right theatre? Eventually is still a finish.
You went into the dam at midnight. Brave. Wet.
Six plaques. Six places. Do not go alone to any.
Second year. You walk faster. Not yet better.
The mall is bright again. Everywhere else, less so.
Money is stored effort. Spend it on skills, friends, shoes.
Your friend's commerce is obstreperously optimistic. …He shouts.
A greedy generator, unplugged by students. Write it down.
Ask my niece. Did you ask properly? Good.
You stayed. Good. Fewer lights. More of us.
Empty halls are louder than full ones.
Garri week comes to us all. Share the cup.
Pusillanimity is not engineering. …Do not be afraid of it.
You heard the tape. Then you know as much as I can say.
Three. Three! …Forgive me. I am just happy.
You are famous now. I am told. I do not have the app.
Fame is a lamp pointed at you. Useful is a lamp you hold.
Do not confuse being seen with being known.
Prestidigitation, with cables. …The trick worked. Do not do it again.
Four. The sky held, and so did Tanko's stair.
The water is quiet again. Thank the eel. Politely.
Finalist. You carry it in your shoulders. Put some down.
Nearly. Nearly is a long word.
When you leave, leave something switched on.
Page two hundred and six. Have you read it? Read it again.
Your project is magnificently, incandescently late. …Hurry.
Did you knock? On every door? Knock on one more.
Everybody came. I did not think they would.
A thing is finished when it no longer needs you.
I kept one light on for a long time. You taught me to share the switch.
Nobody lights a ring alone. I checked. For years.
I laughed twice in forty years. I intend to raise the average.
Thank you. I do not say it enough, and I had a lot of time to practise.
Light travels fast. Kindness travels further.
Slowly. I have nowhere to be. It is a new feeling.
That lamp. I did not have to light it. Look at it.
The goat always comes back. So bring it back properly.
The school is not the buildings. I learned this late. Learn it early.
Somebody chose your door. One day, choose well.
Go on. I will be at the pier at sunset. I am always there now.
Do not sign anything that only says 'Stay'.
Audu's tea, in the morning, sitting down. I recommend it.
I am in a state of quintessential otiosity. …I am resting.
Start small. A torch has never been embarrassed by the sun.
If you are tired, rest. If you are stuck, move. Learn which one it is.
You will forget the grade. You will remember who lent you a pen.
The shortest path is rarely the one with the best suya.
A keeper is not someone who stays. I had the job description wrong.
The clock was right twice a day. So was I. We have both improved.
Half a tower is still the best view on campus.
Call home. They do not need news. They need your voice.
It is allowed to be proud of something small.
Borrow tools. Return them cleaner. This is most of ethics.
Your friends are your backup generator. Service them regularly.
I was a student here longer than was sensible. I recommend five years.
Every lamp. Every one. And none of them mine.
Be the reason the fresher finds the hall.
New faces. Same fear. It passes by the second semester.
The exam ends. The understanding is yours to keep.
A carry-over is a second lecture you paid for with pride.
Whatever it says, you still know what you know.
When they take light, sit near people. That is the whole trick.
The Cup. I hear it from here. Engineering is losing, by the noise.
Gowns again. Every year they look smaller, or I look older.
Ramadan Kareem. Break your fast before you fix anything.
Harmattan. The dust gets into the windings and the temper.
Cold mornings. That bench is still warm. Do not sit on it.
